Unrivaled Heroes: 2.5D Brawler

Oct 14, 2026
Unrivaled Heroes: 2.5D Brawler is 2.5D side-scrolling beat-'em-up where players experience the thrill of multiple unrivaled heroes, each with unique abilities. Master martial arts, unleash powerful skills, and conquer epic bosses. With local co-op for up to 4 players, team up for intense combat and a truly unforgettable adventure. Set in medieval Indonesia, this game transports players to an era where powerful kingdoms ruled over vast archipelagos. Inspired by Indonesian folklore and mythology, legendary tales come to life through epic battles, brought together with stunning visuals that blend 2D and 3D elements. Every chapter unfolds a new story, introducing fresh challenges, characters, and environments to explore. As the journey progresses, uncover deeper lore and unexpected twists that shape the world around you.

Armed with your pickaxe, a glowing companion, and pure determination, you explore ancient caverns, unstable tunnels, and forgotten dungeons filled with mystery.
